name: Learn Spells on Levelup
description: Characters learn class spells automatically on level-up.

keys.label: Enable auto-learn
keys.explain: Master switch: characters learn their class spells automatically on level-up, no trainer visits.

keys.label: Announce at login
keys.explain: Show a short message at login telling the player auto-learn is active.

keys.label: Grant all spells on first login
keys.explain: Give a brand-new character every spell up to its level at once. Handy for instant-level servers.

keys.label: Learn up to level
keys.explain: Stop auto-learning spells past this level.

notes: The conf must exist or the module spams config warnings on every bot login; if the clone ships no conf.dist the defaults above are written under a [worldserver] header. wow-manage.sh 2746-2772.
